messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The billing API depends on the ledger service for invoice postings. [valid 2025-01-09 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-09-2]
- As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service no longer depends on the ledger service. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-23]
- The ledger service relies on the auth gateway for service tokens, so if the auth gateway is down, the ledger service is down. [valid 2025-03-04 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-04]
- The job scheduler depends on the feature-flags service for per-job kill switches. [valid 2025-02-07 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-02-07]
- As of 2026-04-13, the Ember team still owns the reporting service. [valid 2026-04-13 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-13-2]
- The ledger service is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-08 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- As of 2026-05-29, Oskar is on the Ember team on-call rotation as the primary on-call. [valid 2026-05-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-29]
    earlier: As of 2026-01-15, Oskar is off the Ember team on-call rotation. [valid 2026-01-15 to 2026-05-29; recorded by standup/ember/2026-01-15]
- As of 2026-05-29, Oskar is the primary on-call for the Ember team, taking over from Diego. [valid 2026-05-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-29]
    earlier: As of 2026-01-15, Diego is the primary on-call for the Ember team. [valid 2026-01-15 to 2026-05-29; recorded by standup/ember/2026-01-15]
- On 2025-02-21 the Boreal team noticed that the ledger service's memory use had grown steadily for a week after the cache change. [valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-21-2]
- On 2026-04-16 the Atlas team noticed that the ledger service's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change and flagged it because it is not their service. [valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-16]
- As of 2025-11-27, Yuki Tanaka holds the Cinder pager, taking over from Diego, who is leaving the team. [valid 2025-11-27 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-11-27]
    earlier: As of 2025-10-24, Diego holds the Cinder pager this cycle, taking over from Yuki Tanaka. [valid 2025-10-24 to 2025-11-27; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-10-24]
- As of 2026-01-16, Tomasz is off the Dune team on-call rotation. [valid 2026-01-16 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-01-16]
- As of 2026-05-29, Diego is off the Ember team on-call rotation. [valid 2026-05-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-29]
- As of 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings Cinder instead of the Atlas team. [valid 2025-10-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-13-ledger]
- Oskar takes the first on-call shift of the year for the Ember team. [valid 2025-01-14 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-14]
- Priya Raman holds the first on-call rotation for the Atlas team as of 2025-07-30. [valid 2025-07-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-30]
    earlier: Tomasz has the first on-call rotation for the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-07-30; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-09]
- On 2026-05-28 the Ember team noticed that the ledger service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-28 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-28]
- As of 2025-06-24, the reporting service still relies on the ledger service. [valid 2025-06-24 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-06-24]
- As of 2025-08-25, the ledger service only ships on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC; the previous weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC slot is retired. [constraint; valid 2025-08-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-08-25]
    earlier: The ledger service only ships on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-01-14 to 2025-08-25; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-14]
- As of 2026-03-11, the ledger service has a deploy freeze from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 for the fiscal year close. [constraint; valid 2026-03-11 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-03-11]
